RFC 6810 Section 5.1 defines Protocol Version as 0 and states of Max Length: 'This MUST NOT be less than the Prefix Length element.' Current handlePDU still refuses initial version-0 data PDUs before parseIPv4Prefix or parseIPv6Prefix because rtrVersionMin remains 1 (rtr_pdu.go); its Unsupported Protocol Version branch refuses downgrade below rtrVersionMin=1, and syncOnce retries only versions 1 through 2. Adding pduRouterKey staging (a v1/v2 PDU unassigned in v0) does not enable version 0. No test carries this id; the row remains an owed version-0 implementation gap with no credit from v1/v2 parser behavior.
